claim_boundary: Tiny synthetic fixture prompt-only baseline. This is hypothesis evidence, not a benchmark or SOTA claim.

direct_sql_control_outputs.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS campaign_name,
    SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    campaigns c
JOIN 
    order_promotions op ON c.id = op.campaign_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON op.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY 
    c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    c.country_code,
    SUM(o.amount) AS revenue
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY 
    c.country_code
ORDER BY 
    revenue DESC;

The 5-step LoRA arm did not improve this tiny fixture slice over the prompt-only baseline.
